## The claim

P4-1a: at least 99 % of the callset's coding alleles get a non-null hgvs_p or hgvs_c from the VEP HGVS pass, so one normalized allele record can key every tier-1 model lookup.

**Prediction if true.** The step-1 run's RunSummary reports p4_1a_fraction >= 0.99 over the coding (non read-only) alleles of results.it4_allele_records.

**What would refute it.** p4_1a_fraction below 0.95 — then the failing consequence class is named from RunSummary.by_consequence and tier-1 coverage is reported per class.

## Evidence

| # | Direction | Strength | Kind | Observation | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 130 | supports | 0.90 | measurement | The full step-1 pass spelled 38,069 of 38,087 coding alleles with a cDNA or protein HGVS string: p4_1a_fraction = 0.99953, above the 0.99 the claim predicted and far above the 0.95 that would refute it. | `docs/iteration4/step-1/methodology/114-one-record-per-allele-and-what-it-can-be-spelled-as.md` |
| 131 | supports | 0.50 | measurement | The 18 unspelled coding alleles are 9 upstream_gene_variant, 5 downstream_gene_variant, 1 intergenic_variant, 1 stop_gained, 1 3_prime_UTR_variant and 1 incomplete_terminal_codon_variant — 14 of them outside any transcript, so no consequence class the zoo scores is materially unspelled. | `docs/iteration4/step-1/methodology/114-one-record-per-allele-and-what-it-can-be-spelled-as.md` |
| 132 | supports | 0.40 | measurement | The record set holds 39,286 rows = 38,087 distinct coding alleles plus exactly 1,199 read-only alleles, and the parquet's sha256 equals the provenance manifest's, so neither the read-only union nor the id dedupe mis-fired. | `docs/iteration4/step-1/methodology/114-one-record-per-allele-and-what-it-can-be-spelled-as.md` |

  +0.800  supports 0.40 — The record set holds 39,286 rows = 38,087 distinct coding alleles plus exactly 1,199 read-only alleles, and the parquet's sha256 equals the provenance manifest's, so neither the read-only union nor the id dedupe mis-fired.   -> 0.973

The weighing is a transparent heuristic for triage, not a calibrated posterior: the strengths are human judgments, and rows drawn from the same underlying data are not independent the way the sum treats them.
